title: Q-ULTRA-air-quality-value-3: The tenant's own declared value metric out of bounds: retire: the measured value does not justify the cost (air-quality; verb retire)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** essential variable `air-quality:value` out of bounds (reading 0.0; limits 1.0 to None)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation ultrastability --check
**Status:** open

ULTRASTABILITY-1 second-order step: retire: the measured value does not justify the cost (air-quality; verb retire). A system with no measure that can be wrong cannot be improved. Read as the tenant's declared metric divided by its own declared target (ops/tenants/<slug>.json declared_metric, declared_target); 1.0 is on target.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation ultrastability --tick` reads `value` inside its bounds.
